messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all‑hands — opening this thread for any clarifying Qs about travel allowances, team offsites, hub passes, desk booking, and visa support. I'll try to answer or loop in folks.
Sam H.: Thanks! Question — for a small 3‑day engineering offsite, what budget can teams expect per head?
Priya (People Ops): Short answer: teams get an offsite stipend per person + central budget for venue if approved. Typical stipend is $600/person for domestic 3‑day offsites; international is handled case‑by‑case. Need pre‑approval from your manager + fill the offsite request form.
Jared T.: Where's the form? And is airfare covered up front or reimbursed?
People Ops Bot: Offsite policy & request form: https://redwood.internal/policies/offsite‑policy (use expense code EXP‑OFFSITE).
Maya R. (Finance): Reimbursements: submit receipts in Concur within 30 days. Airfare is reimbursed — we can do direct billing for venues with Finance approval. Per‑diem option available if you prefer not to itemize meals.
Sam H.: If someone needs a visa letter, what's the timeline?
Priya (People Ops): Visa note — reach out at least 8 weeks before travel. We'll provide an invitation + letter and escalate with Finance for any visa fee reimbursements. If it's urgent, ping me and Kate.
Kevin S. (Facilities): Desk booking + hub passes: folks coming into a hub should reserve desks via the Office Portal (Office › Book a Desk). If you're on a team offsite, reserve the meeting room in the portal and use the tag "Offsite — Team Name" so we can prep AV. Hub pass link: https://redwood.internal/hubs/booking
Jared T.: Are there limits on how many people from one team can book a hub desk that day?
Kevin S. (Facilities): We prioritize based on office capacity; usually no hard cap but if demand spikes we work with people ops to allocate. For multi‑team offsites that use the office as a base, please add the event to the hub calendar so we can manage space.
Sam H.: For international travel, does Redwood cover travel insurance?
Maya R. (Finance): Yes, for company‑approved international trips we cover basic travel insurance. Fill the travel insurance section on the offsite form so we can enroll attendees.
Priya (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) Submit offsite request form 2) Get manager + budget approval 3) Book travel (use Expedia/Concur) 4) Submit receipts in Concur with EXP‑OFFSITE 5) Book desks/rooms in Office Portal 6) If visa needed, contact People Ops 8+ weeks out.
Sam H.: Thanks — super helpful. One more: do we have guidance for childcare travel reimbursements?
Priya (People Ops): We reimburse reasonable childcare costs tied to company travel; include receipts and a short note in Concur, we'll route to People Ops for approval.
Kate L. (CEO): Quick note from leadership — we want offsites to be inclusive and cost‑efficient. If a team requests higher per‑person spend for a special program, include a short rationale in the form and we'll review with Finance. Also, remote‑first remains our default — use offsites to build connection, not to replace everyday remote flexibility.
Sam H.: Great — thanks @Priya @Kate. I'll start the form this week.
Priya (People Ops): Perfect — ping me if you want a quick pre‑review before submitting. :party_parrot:
